uniques.Name: Dwarven Rune of the Long Winter
uniques.Flavour: The winter under the mountain has no spring. All it wants is a door.

uniques.Name: Dwarven Rune of the Grave-Rot
uniques.Flavour: Carved in a barrow wall. The rot grew back along the same lines.

uniques.Name: Dwarven Rune of the Snare Line
uniques.Flavour: Every tunnel had one. Nobody ever saw it twice.

uniques.Name: The Vigil-Ember
uniques.Flavour: A coal from the hall's last vigil. It glows brighter at the hour of prayer.

uniques.Name: Rimeglass of the Deep Pass
uniques.Flavour: Ice from a pass no summer has reached, cut into a lens.

uniques.Name: The Engineer's Last Gear
uniques.Flavour: The last gear of the last engine. It turns on its own.

uniques.Name: The Oathwarden's Chain
uniques.Flavour: He held the sky with it. When the oath broke, he let go.

Mods.Text: 50% of Physical damage Converted to Lightning damage

uniques.Name: Link of the Sundered Chain
uniques.Flavour: One link of the chain that bound the sky. It pulls toward the next.

Mods.Text: Your Projectiles Chain +1 time

uniques.Name: Dwarven Rune of the Falling Sky
uniques.Flavour: Carved on the last island as it fell. The rest of the sky is on its way.

uniques.Name: Deep-Forged Band
uniques.Flavour: Hammered in the Deep Forge, where the dwarves sealed their oaths in stone.

uniques.Name: Deep-Forged Torc
uniques.Flavour: The forge-masters wore one rune at the throat. They said it listened.

uniques.Name: Deepwarden's Lantern
uniques.Flavour: The wardens carried one light into the Deep. The light came back.

uniques.Name: Gravecut
uniques.Flavour: Forged below the last stair, where the oath was buried and the blade was not.

uniques.Name: Ossuary Stride

uniques.Name: The Unspoken Edge

uniques.Name: Crown of the Unbroken

uniques.Name: The Mirror Oath
uniques.Flavour: Two promises, made to the same face.

uniques.Name: The Last Feast
uniques.Flavour: Nothing poisons the one who ate it all.

uniques.Name: Overclock Coil
uniques.Flavour: Rated for one charge. Nobody stops at one.

uniques.Name: Tickstep Treads

uniques.Name: The Hollow Star
uniques.Flavour: It ate the stars one oath at a time. The last one, it wore.

uniques.Name: Ashbrand of the Tyrant
uniques.Flavour: Massad burned for a year. He carried the brand that lit it.

uniques.Name: The Glacier's Oath

uniques.Name: Veinwrit Grips

uniques.Name: Rimecrown

uniques.Name: Cinderwick

uniques.Name: Veilmother's Vestment
uniques.Flavour: The veil tears. The veil comes back.

uniques.Name: Soulsip Wraps

uniques.Name: Weeping Talons
uniques.Flavour: The wound stays open. The next one is already on its way.

uniques.Name: The Pale Rake

uniques.Name: The Quiet Verdict

uniques.Name: Twinscar

uniques.Flavour: Every road was someone else's idea.

Mods.Text: Your Movement Skills have no Cooldown (only a quarter-second pause between uses)
Each use of a Movement Skill costs 4% of your maximum Life and Energy Shield

uniques.Name: Sentence of the Ninth Bell
uniques.Flavour: Nine strokes for the guilty. The bell does not ask how many were meant.

Mods.Text: Your Poisons never expire on enemies under your Sentence of Rot
Every ninth Poison you lay on an enemy under your Sentence of Rot tolls the bell: your Poisons on it deal one second of their damage at once

uniques.Name: The Eighth Blade Ornament
uniques.Flavour: Seven blades for the war. The eighth was kept for the one who started it.

Mods.Text: Sheathe gathers your Blade Vortex blades: your next Iaido Thrust looses them all at the enemy it hits, each striking for 12% of that hit, then they return

uniques.Name: The Hollow Throne
uniques.Flavour: The throne was empty long before the king stopped breathing.

Mods.Text: Your Skeletal Mages lay the Woes on your skill bar on enemies they hit that have room for another Woe

uniques.Name: Tithe of the Red Furrow
uniques.Flavour: The field took a tenth of every man who crossed it. It was never the same tenth.

Mods.Text: Your Bleeds on enemies you Sentenced have +{v}% to Damage over Time Multiplier

uniques.Name: Rampart of Embers
uniques.Flavour: The wall burned for nine days. On the tenth they carried it into battle.

Mods.Text: {v}% of Physical Skills' Damage Converted to Fire damage
Your Ignites stack: +{v} more on each enemy
Blocking grants a Fury charge (at most once a second)

uniques.Name: Thunder-Anvil Greaves
uniques.Flavour: Each step is a hammer blow. The storm counts them.

Mods.Text: {v}% of Physical Slam Skills' Damage Converted to Lightning damage
Killing a Shocked enemy with a Slam grants a Fury charge (at most 2 a second)

uniques.Name: Rotfang Cleaver
uniques.Flavour: The butcher stopped washing it. The meat stopped needing salt.

Mods.Text: Your hits lay the Woes on your skill bar on the enemies they strike, as a Woe Bearer does

uniques.Name: Tempest Hex Ring
uniques.Flavour: A curse spoken in a storm travels farther than the one who spoke it.

Mods.Text: Your Woes build Dread {v}% faster and last {v}% longer

uniques.Name: Crimson Petal Blades
uniques.Flavour: In the east they say a duel is over when the blossoms stop falling.

Mods.Text: Your Bleeds stack: up to {v} more on each enemy; each extra Bleed deals 65% less
Once a second, your hit on an enemy you Sentenced is a Critical Strike

uniques.Name: Gale-Edge Wakizashi
uniques.Flavour: Draw it into the wind and the wind draws too.

Mods.Text: Crescent Slash waves Fork 1 time
Grants Mistwalker: a critical strike makes you Elusive for 2 seconds (20% less damage taken from hits, 15% increased movement speed)

uniques.Name: The Woeweaver's Grasp
uniques.Flavour: Two threads in one hand. Neither pulled as tight as it could be.

uniques.Name: The Mana-Ward Signet
uniques.Flavour: The mind is a wall. Pay the mason.

Mods.Text: Oath of Stillness: each second you stand still, 3% less damage taken (15% at most). Moving breaks it

uniques.Name: Frostgrave Maul
uniques.Flavour: Where it falls, winter is buried standing up.

uniques.Name: Judicator's Gavel

While no enemy is Sentenced by you, your Judgement critical strikes Sentence the enemy they hit

uniques.Name: The Radiant Wheel

Mods.Text: Your Holy Slash critical strikes throw a ring of light: enemies within 3 metres take 40% of the hit as Physical damage (at most once every 0.3 seconds)

uniques.Name: Firebrand Codex

uniques.Name: Raijin's Fist

uniques.Name: Marrow Reliquary

uniques.Name: The Grey Covenant

{v}% of your hit damage is laid on the enemy as your Entropy instead of striking

uniques.Name: Carrion Lantern
